mismatches: The base plate footprint (x-extent) is approximately 102mm (-56.7 to 45), which exceeds the design document's constraint of x in [-45, 45] and the requirement R2 for a 100x100mm footprint.
The base plate width (y-extent) is 50mm (-25 to 25), whereas the design document specifies a width of 90mm (y in [-45, 45]).
The support spine appears much thicker and more massive than the 'slimmed-down' structural member (thickness ~4mm) described in the design document.
summary: The part exceeds the specified base plate dimensions and is significantly bulkier than the lightweight skeletal design intended.
